ValidationRule.description: Prevent users from editing the case when the status is 'Completed,' excluding DM and TL roles.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Validation_Rule), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Withdrawn"), NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName = "Decision_Managers_Team_Leaders"), NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.Persona__c, 'Decision Manager')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This case has been marked as Withdrawn and can no longer be edited.
